## Goal
[One sentence: what the player gets and why.]

## Decisions
<!-- Each box triggers extra steps in "Workflow steps" below. -->
- [ ] **Public (Steam Workshop item)**: leave unticked for private / local only (`Documents\DYSMANTLE Mods\`)
- [ ] **Preview icon / pictogram** (`preview.jpg` next to `mod-info.xml`, like `my-mods/level-up-faster/preview.jpg`)
- [ ] **Generated by a script** (`tools/make_[mod_name].py` via `tools/modlib.py`); otherwise hand-written files
- [ ] **Needs the game unpacked** (`unpacked/data-windows/`) as source for overriding files
- [ ] **Depends on or builds on another of my mods**: which: [mod-name]
- [ ] **Replaces / supersedes an existing mod**: which: [mod-name] (never enable both)
- [ ] **Requires a DLC** (e.g. Underworld): which: [DLC]
- [ ] **Changes save-affecting state** (new items, quests, recipes, flags): saves must be backed up before testing

### Out of scope
- [Thing not part of this mod]

## Conflict check (required before implementing)
<!-- Mods that override the same path do not merge: the later load wins, silently. -->
- [ ] Compared planned paths with other folders in `my-mods/` (`git ls-files my-mods | grep [path]`) and the "File ownership" table in `docs/modding-notes.md`
- [ ] Compared planned paths with enabled Workshop mods in `docs/active-mods.reference.xml` (IDs are Workshop item IDs; check each mod's page or files for the same paths)
- [ ] Overlaps found: [none | list: path -> other mod -> resolution]
- Resolution options, in order of preference: (1) a different file or hook, (2) merge into one generated file via a shared generator, (3) set `load_priority` so this mod loads after the one it builds on, (4) document "do not enable together" in `description` and README
- [ ] If this mod takes ownership of a path, add it to "File ownership" in `docs/modding-notes.md`

## Workflow steps
1. [ ] Validate: issue still wanted, no existing mod already does it (`my-mods/`, Workshop)
2. [ ] Research the game data; record verified findings or gotchas in `docs/modding-notes.md`
3. [ ] Create `my-mods/[mod-name]/mod-info.xml` (copy `my-mods/faster-farming/mod-info.xml`; `required_program_id` DYSMANTLE, `required_mod_api_version` 1; without it `deploy-mods.ps1` skips the folder)
4. [ ] Implement the override files (or generator `tools/make_[mod_name].py`, using `patch_once()` so a game update fails loudly); do not hand-edit generated files
5. [ ] Update the `README.md` mod table and `docs/ideas-and-tasks.md`
6. [ ] Test (see below), record the result in this issue
7. [ ] PR (`Closes #NNN`), squash merge, delete branch

**Only if public (Workshop):**
- [ ] `preview.jpg` present, `title` and `description` final, no personal data or local paths in any file
- [ ] Tested on a clean or backed-up save with no other mods enabled
- [ ] Upload through the in-game Mods menu (hammer & wrench icon, see `KIT_README_official.txt`). The developers do not document the upload steps, so note what you did: [steps]
- [ ] Record the Workshop item ID in the README and in this issue: [ID]
- [ ] Do not edit the subscribed Workshop copy; re-upload from `my-mods/`

**Only if private (local):**
- [ ] Deployed only via `scripts/deploy-mods.ps1`

**Only if preview icon:**
- [ ] [Describe or attach the image: size/theme/idea] (JPG, original work or properly licensed)

## Install and test
<!-- Back up saves first. The kit warns that mods can corrupt saves. -->
1. Close the game. `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\backup-saves.ps1`
2. `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\deploy-mods.ps1`
3. Steam launch option: `--features MODS`
4. In game: Mods > enable the mod > **Apply Mods** (restart if needed)
5. **Check `%APPDATA%\10tons\DYSMANTLE\active-mods.xml` lists the mod with `enabled="true"`.** A deployed mod that is not listed does nothing (this is why the campfire mod seemed broken, see `docs/open-issues.md` #1)
6. Test in isolation (disable other mods that touch the same paths), then again with the normal mod set

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] [Observable in-game result 1, with the expected number or behaviour]
- [ ] [Observable in-game result 2]
- [ ] Still works together with the normal enabled mod set (conflict check passed)
- [ ] Game starts and an existing save loads without errors
- [ ] Mod disabled again: the game returns to vanilla behaviour
- [ ] Docs updated (README table, modding notes, file ownership)

## Test result
<!-- Fill after testing. "untested" is a valid status; say so in the README table. -->
- Game version / date: [version, date]
- Result: [pass | fail | untested]: [notes, exact in-game hint text if something is missing]
